record.paper: On the Complexity of Digraph Colourings and Vertex Arboricity

dossier_meta.paper: On the Complexity of Digraph Colourings and Vertex Arboricity
dossier_meta.statement_text: Let $p\geq 1$ be a fixed real number. Instance: A (multi-)digraph $D$. Decide whether $\vec{\chi}_{f}(D)\leq p$.
dossier_meta.context_text: This problem asks for the complexity of deciding whether the fractional dichromatic number of a digraph is at most $p$. The paper proves NP-completeness for all real $p>1$ with $p\neq 2$, mirroring results of Feder et al. for the circular dichromatic number; the case $p=2$ is explicitly left open.
